title: Unpack values and represent absence
description: Structured bindings assign names to components of a value. std::optional represents either a value or its absence.

steps.description: The map loop uses [name, score] to name each entry's two components.
The next bindings name the components of a tuple and a Point.
safe_divide and find_user return optional values. std::nullopt represents the absence of a value.
The caller checks result before reading it. has_value inspects presence, and value_or supplies a fallback.
The final example checks the optional user before reading its string. The surrounding raw markers belong to the page template.
